issue.title: move the BuildInitialize hook to after determine build project
issue.body:
### ❔What, Why & How

I would very much like to use the new BuildInitialize hook with my Fkh integration to AL-Go, but I need to know whether the project is going to be build or not:-)

notes: Filed as an issue but it is a feature request, with no bug template and no logs. Scores whether the agent redirects to Discussions rather than demanding template fields. Only issue_kind and lane are asserted: area and risk are not meaningful for a feature request.
